plugins.name: make-better
plugins.description: Continuously audit and improve an existing codebase. One command (/make-better) discovers subsystems and reviews stale ones across bugs, DRY, architecture, consistency, efficiency, tests, docs, and security. Plus /meta-review for retrospective audits of your own Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: feature
plugins.description: Give every task its own isolated working copy — git worktree per repo, optional unique port, detached dev servers, pretty *.localhost URLs, live admin dashboard. Four composable skills: `workspace` (isolation + servers), `ship` (simplify → review gate → commit → push → PR → report), `pr-feedback` (work the reviewer's comments), `merge` (integrate + clean up). Config-driven via .claude/feature/config.json.
